step: Check installed-baseline updater before starting a newer compile
evidence: Completed GitHub job metadata and newly permitted job-log fetch; no previously denied log/artifact route retried.
diagnosis: The baseline observer used the strict OTA-metadata duplicate parser on the entire VENDOR/build.prop. Required identity checks need only unique consistent values for the three selected identity properties, not uniqueness of every unrelated vendor property.
correction: Scope build.prop parsing to the required device/build/time values; reject missing/conflicting identity values, permit unrelated repeats and identical repeated identity values. Keep OTA metadata duplicate rejection unchanged.
